key_insight: TRACE is an energy-conserving transformer-style interatomic potential that uses O(3)-equivariant cluster-expansion correlations plus local cross-attention to model complex chemistry without passing learned state between atoms.
engineering_relevance: It offers a unified, scalable path to simulate polymorphs, liquids, and reaction barriers on modest hardware while preserving physically meaningful symmetry and energy conservation.
method: ACE density correlations create an O(3)-equivariant center state.
Local multihead cross-attention queries fixed neighbor tensor features based on species and geometry.
No learned hidden state is propagated between atoms, simplifying the architecture and supporting stable molecular dynamics.
